programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: 十四女英豪
programme.desc: 赤胆忠心的杨家将，世世代代为国而战，子子孙孙为民而死，直战到最后一员虎将杨宗保，不幸在金山之役中了埋伏，全营将士壮烈牺牲。杨宗保身负箭伤，被困金山，以身殉国。杨家满门为保卫宋朝江山及替杨宗保报仇，在老祖母佘老太君的发起下，组成了一支杨家军，誓与番邦周旋到底!

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: 春暖花开
programme.desc: 故事描述，陈太太有女洁玉及美玉，洁玉已工作，美玉仍求学。适逢陈家有空房出租，少奇来租，一谈即合；洁玉三个姐姐，皆与租客结婚，所以洁玉表姐赵静兰之母决仿效陈家租房选婿。未几，一医科学生欣农来租房，赵母见他是理想快婿，忙出租。原来少奇与欣农是同学，少奇老成寡言，被洁玉、美玉视为怪人，欣农则只顾谈恋爱...

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: 荒江女侠
programme.desc: 铁臂金刚方甯、方静押送赈银救济黄河灾民，途中受到盗寇的突袭，全家老少遭杀害，惟稚女方瑛琪为玄真道长救出，抱入深山抚养。瑛琪长成后，尽得玄真道长武功真传。其时金兵图大举进犯中原，玄真道长授瑛琪一剑一信，著其下山投效义军首领夏子龙...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: 杨乃武与小白菜
programme.desc: 剧情讲述，知县之子刘子和，垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜，用迷药将其奸污。刘子和事后恐东窗事发，用砒霜毒死葛小大。葛死后，镇内流言四起，知县为救爱儿，设计嫁祸小白菜婚前恋人杨乃武。乃武被苦打成招，其姐杨淑英不忍见弟含冤而死，到刑部要求翻案......

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death-a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: 飞燕金刀
programme.desc: 总镖头李志山的妻子私通对头人龙震天，并设计先偷飞龙刀，再杀害李志山及女儿小燕，幸好最后李氏父女成功逃脱。小燕长大后，更成为武功高强的女剑客，誓要为死去的母亲报仇。直至一个偶然的机会，小燕遇到仍然在生的母亲，才骇然发现真相，原来自己一直被父亲的谎言所蒙骗。

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: 射雕英雄传续集
programme.desc: 欧阳锋得悉郭靖以九阴真经的功夫于选婿比武中获胜，并娶得黄蓉为妻，于是把黄蓉挟走，要胁郭靖要默写九阴真经才会释放黄蓉。最终郭靖会否为救出黄蓉而就范？

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: 无名英雄
programme.desc: 街头浪荡客孟刚与铁虎虽玩世不恭，却心怀侠义。一次偶然，孟刚结识革命军首领万泰，在其感召下，两兄弟决心投身革命。在孟刚女友的协助下，他们成功潜入军阀阵营，智取军火送往前线。然而，在与军阀的激战中，三人相继壮烈牺牲，成为湮没于历史中的「无名英雄」。

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: 玫瑰我爱你
programme.desc: 十八岁的玫瑰在澳门结识了富家子家聪。太平洋战争爆发，两人被迫分手。七年后，玫瑰得知家聪结婚，伤心痛哭。玫瑰婚后，丈夫去世，开了一间花店，一天，小女孩来买花，才知小女孩是自己女儿，更与家聪重遇...文艺导演秦剑的爱情悲喜剧，保持作深情，感人之水准。

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: 五毒天罗
programme.desc: 《五毒天罗》是武林至毒之物，不知收藏何方。五毒教的蛇坛主，要找出天罗所在，独霸武林，误放消息，谓天罗已重现武林，江湖一片风声鹤唳...

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: 凤还巢
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦将次女雪娥许配予好友之子穆居易，庶室程夫人既愤且恼，对居易讹称长女雪雁乃雪娥，催促二人早日成亲。居易见雪雁貌丑而痴，吓得留书出走。富豪朱焕然对雪娥心仪已久，趁此良机冒充居易，依期迎亲......本片由李香君、金峰分饰男、女主角，配搭新鲜；而蒋光超与庄元庸一胖一瘦的谐趣演出，更令人笑破肚皮。

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: 奇门怪招烂头蟀
programme.desc: 受到《醉拳》启发，这部功夫喜剧描述一名傻头傻脑的功夫小子自创了一套蟋蟀拳，其后更逐一打败曾欺凌他的武林人士。

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: 娃娃夫人
programme.desc: 三十五岁的男教师林明娶了十七岁的女学生珍珍。两人在同一学校上课，隐藏夫妻秘密。珍发觉林明常被女生包围，而林又发现珍常被男老师追求，期间笑料百出。

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: 文素臣
programme.desc: 「龙门七侠」之首文素臣命六侠入昭庆寺探察，他们不慎被主持明空杀害。明空更设计杀害林巡按，幸得文所救。文素臣潜入寺内与明空一战为六侠报仇，林巡按下令官兵攻入昭庆寺，联合文歼灭所有奸僧。

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: 阿牛发达记
programme.desc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠宝，从此富贵。这时，周大叔假意叫他签约迎娶一名女子，却原来是个陷阱，为的是要卖掉他的房子。最后，可怜的阿牛又回复一贫如洗...

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: 儒侠
programme.desc: 年轻剑客沈秉义受命出任爱国组织「日月会」总舵主，誓要讨伐勾结外敌、祸国殃民的大将军。在舍身报国的征途中，他先后邂逅豪爽女侠与两位美若天仙的维族公主。面对国仇家恨与三段缠绵深情，这位剑客陷入了情义两难的抉择。

programme.title: 儒侠
programme.desc: 年轻剑客沈秉义受命出任爱国组织「日月会」总舵主，誓要讨伐勾结外敌、祸国殃民的大将军。在舍身报国的征途中，他先后邂逅豪爽女侠与两位美若天仙的维族公主。面对国仇家恨与三段缠绵深情，这位剑客陷入了情义两难的抉择。

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: 钻石艳盗
programme.desc: 两大珠宝盗贼「夜来香」和「夜爵士」前往日本，意图偷去「维纳斯的眼泪」巨钻。二人见面后即坠入爱河，却不知道原来对方同为盗取巨钻的竞敌。最后谁会得到巨钻？二人的恋情又会否无疾而终？

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: 陆小凤之决战前后
programme.desc: 两大武林剑客叶孤城与西门吹雪将于紫禁城决斗。陆小凤忖度二人素末谋面，又无利益冲突，无须决斗，猜想当中一定事有蹊跷。于是，他决定和花满楼前往京城调查清楚，却发现当中隐藏的阴谋...

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: 王昭君
programme.desc: 王昭君拒绝贿赂画师，于是一直被画师画丑致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君后，惊为天人，即选中她。画师被逐后，为报复而设计将昭君与匈奴可汗和亲。皇帝因拒绝婚事即引来两国争战，以致王昭君最后为了平息战乱不得不牺牲自己。

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: 英雄无泪
programme.desc: 江湖异人萧大师铸成宝剑「泪痕剑」，不料该剑显现出凶兆，将会带来武林浩劫，而他的亲生子注定要死在此剑之下。萧为了使此剑不危害江湖，将它交给一位淡薄名利的弟子保管。数十年后该弟子把它传给门徒小高，令其带剑下山望化解江湖劫数。

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: 没有老公的日子
programme.desc: 黄太太独力抚养儿子Alex成人，与媳妇阿彤一起生活。岂料Alex意外逝世，死前道出外遇女友黑仔已怀有身孕。结果三名没有老公的女人同住一室...

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: 盘丝洞
programme.desc: 本片为邵氏「西游记」系列的第三部作品。唐僧落入了七位蜘蛛精的手中，希望食唐僧肉而得到永生。悟空、八戒和沙僧因此大闹盘丝洞拯救唐僧。

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: 茅山僵尸拳
programme.desc: 以「赶尸」为业的陈师父与徒弟受托押运九具僵尸，启程上路。未料途中两具竟逃脱。其中一具实际上并非僵尸，而是为躲避敌人追杀而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是，此人与陈师父同样身怀绝技，二人皆为深不可测的武林高手！

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: 中国超人
programme.desc: 太空科学研究深所获悉有来自冰河时代的人类所化之怪物将会危及地球上的所有人类。这批怪物凶悍异常，神通广大，大有霸占整个世界的野心。为了对付这批怪物，科学研究所所长刘英德以自己数十年来的研究心得把勇敢的科学研究员雷马制造成万能超人。中国超人开始了与怪物的战斗......

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: 大地儿女
programme.desc: 这是一部经典战争钜片，描述抗日战争时人民的生活状况。画家俞瑞意外救了由乡下被拐卖来的女子荷花。两人互生情愫，不久更结为夫妻过著幸福的日子。无奈好景不常，不久日军全面侵入中国，亦正式展开残酷的统治...

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: 邪斗邪
programme.desc: 余腩沉溺赌海，由于欠债累累无力偿还，遂答应债主以其妻肉偿债项。事件被其妻识破，并决意离余而去。余动轻生念头，可最终自杀未遂。余遇上一名富家老伯，老伯答应给余巨额现金，只要余答应帮他娶得美人归...

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: 插翅难飞
programme.desc: 邓彪因为黑货买卖失手，遂逼江湖人物高明供出从中陷害者，高明说出乃黑豹所为后，即被开枪杀死，邓彪因此被判监禁十五年。他出狱后即找黑豹报仇，却遇上势力庞大的葛八爷干扰；同时商琳为寻失踪十五年的丈夫，欲找邓彪查问黑豹下落，但两人仅听过黑豹其名，从未见其人，究竟黑豹是谁？

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: 仙女下凡
programme.desc: 天宫仙女七妹向往凡间生活，某夜偷驾祥云下凡来到香港。初到人间的她人生地不熟，险遭不法之徒欺骗，幸得经营负债累累孤儿院的董自立相救。面对贪婪富商觊觎院址、步步紧逼，七妹屡施法术相助，却屡遭误解为妖魅。两人在困境中互相扶持，情愫渐生，共同守护孤儿院的未来。

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: 西游记
programme.desc: 本片根据中国经典同名名著改编。故事讲述唐僧赴西天取经，中途在五指山收服马骝精；在高家庄收服猪八戒；在流沙河收服沙悟净的种种情节。。

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: 舞衣
programme.desc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅，与空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住，三女各有爱情际遇；白眉虽爱钱，却倾情自称从外地来的路俊，两人只好互许后会有期之愿；朱黛曾迷恋已婚飞机师，分手后又爱上赛车手；姚姚的最大心愿是把清白之躯留给丈夫，她本最爱穷工人李吉，李吉却因自卑而忍痛分手，姚姚嫁予富家子，却仍挂念李吉...

programme.title: 舞衣
programme.desc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅，与空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住，三女各有爱情际遇；白眉虽爱钱，却倾情自称从外地来的路俊，两人只好互许后会有期之愿；朱黛曾迷恋已婚飞机师，分手后又爱上赛车手；姚姚的最大心愿是把清白之躯留给丈夫，她本最爱穷工人李吉，李吉却因自卑而忍痛分手，姚姚嫁予富家子，却仍挂念李吉...

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: 来如风
programme.desc: 明皇身染恶疾，驾崩在即，却无子可继帝位；皇侄世子杰本可继位，惜不成器，难当大任。皇弟徽王想起明皇曾与东宫宫女生有子女各一，现时藏匿于东阳县，遂命锦衣卫刘玄平寻找公主与王子的下落。刘玄平路上屡遭世子杰爪牙追杀，幸得侠士来如风相助...

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: 蛇王子
programme.desc: 广西蛇山中有三条巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇将及黄蛇将；一夜三蛇化成人形与苗寨男女载歌载舞，蛇王子更因此爱上苗寨女子黑琴。后苗寨旱灾，蛇王子答应率蛇作法，引水入寨，但条件是要娶黑琴为妻...

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: 荡寇志
programme.desc: 张彻导演的武侠钜作《水浒传》的延续。七大梁山的英雄义士为保国家，奉命征讨宦官专权。展开一场轰轰烈烈之荡寇大决战。

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: 青春恋
programme.desc: 酷爱音乐的留学生李英伟临危受命替老父接管公司，其嬉皮士形像为祖母不屑。李的公司职员林仲鹏乘机制造事端，图谋夺取其总经理之职位。李之青梅竹马朋友王凤不忍见李受屈，化身金发美人巧施妙计助他解困，自此李对此神秘女郎一见钟情 。

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: 武林风云
programme.desc: 故事描述，武义亲王恃势弄权，为夺紫光剑，不惜害死甘大雄、迫走徐牧，并命其子鲁天霞率恶家奴直闯甘家堡，借吊祭为名，实以武力夺剑。甘氏三女胜男、亚男、超男惶然之际，表亲徐进到访，联手杀退恶奴，但大战中，徐进、胜男等受伤，无恙的亚男遂往飞虎岭邀救兵......

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: 冰天侠女
programme.desc: 沈冰红幼时目击父母遭高允及结拜弟兄杀害，双脚更被冻至残废；长大后练就非凡武功，矢志复仇。后冰红与高允次子高天英结识，天英虽知冰红为报仇而来，却对她的遭遇非常同情，主动为她治好脚疾......

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: 鬼画符
programme.desc: 周鹏被神捕诸葛森追杀，投靠表兄包妥。林家大少奶被男鬼杜洛所杀，要求鹏二人带其鬼魂上路，到开封找公孙先生消灭杜鬼魂。鹏以大少奶的鬼符在赌场赢取路费，更与戏子吴顺超一同上路...

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: 蓝与黑续集
programme.desc: 剧情承接上集，唐琪结束夜总会歌女生涯，在战乱中跑遍中国寻找爱人张醒亚，但醒亚却纠缠于日军，叛乱分子及将军的美丽女儿当中。

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: 成记茶楼
programme.desc: 大哥成从大陆逃到香港，在屋邨经营茶楼，本想安分守己，却屡遭恶势力挑衅，而警方却袖手旁观，迫使大哥成和茶楼的朋友们决定以牙还牙！

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: 林冲夜奔
programme.desc: 此片述说了关于林冲的故事。宋朝禁军教头林冲遭受贪官陷害，被放逐沧州，更陷入险境。幸得花和尚相助，林冲成功脱险，更展开复仇大计。

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: 邪完再邪
programme.desc: 女鬼刘阿翠钟情以前邻居马素，欲与其结合，央求父亲携同金银珠宝向马提亲，撮合一段人鬼姻缘，马素年青憨直，不愿与鬼为伍，坚决拒绝，实则彼暗恋已有男友之邻居红卜卜，阿翠洞悉其情，决定伺机行动。

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: 广东十虎与后五虎
programme.desc: 广东十虎之一谭敏之侄谭聪，在赌馆当巡场；一夜，十虎的徒弟及后人等四人，在赌场相聚时，旗人佟七带着前清官之子小虎突袭，把谭聪杀死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、谭敏等，昔日曾把父杀死，以助反清义士蔡民义脱险。小虎遂与师叔们联手，杀死仍在世的十虎及其后人、传人，为父报仇...

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: 至尊一剑
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新剑术高超，连败九十九名剑手，终在最后一击败在剑神手上。五新知其欠缺一柄宝剑，遂杀死著名铸剑师老鹰，夺取稀世的「老鹰宝剑」。老鹰之子燕北悲痛万分，矢誓报仇，不自量力挑战五新，结果被打落悬崖之下...

programme.title: On The Way

programme.title: Memory Of China
programme.desc: Memory Of China unveils secrets of important historical events, mega projects and the untold stories behind the crucial decisions of this country.

programme.title: 国家记忆
programme.desc: 中国第一档国史节目，展现党史、国史、军史中的重大历史事件、各领域重大工程建设、揭秘重大决策背后的故事、讲述各阶层各时代代表性人物，记录讲述党的奋斗史、创业史、中国特色社会主义探索史、改革开放进程史。

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: 猩猩王
programme.desc: 探险家陈正风（李修贤）受聘赴印度森林搜捕猩猩王，结果误堕娱乐公司老板鲁天（谷峰）的圈套，将猩猩王带往香港表演。同行的「女泰山」阿维（伊芙莲嘉）见猩猩王惨遭捉弄摆布，伤心之余更被鲁天意图强奸。猩猩王睹状狂性大发，追击鲁天至市区，市民一片慌乱，军警如临大敌...全片的特技道具，一丝不苟，猩猩王爬上香港当时最高建筑物康乐大厦的镜头，令观众惊异万分。导演远赴泰国森林取景，还有野性美丽的女泰山伊芙莲嘉演出，令人大饱眼福。

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: 缘份
programme.desc: 一个刚毕业的年青人在地铁站内邂逅一个美丽动人的女子，并对她一见钟情。在另一方面，他正被一个富家女展开追求。而此时他倾心的那女子，也正周旋于一个已婚男子之中。当那年青人向她表白时，那女子要求与他在地铁站内玩捉迷藏来决定大家的缘份！

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: 军火大劫案
programme.desc: 特工阿文被安排潜伏于东南亚的军火商旗下，寻找其手中的一批军火炸药并将其销毁。当他终于找到该批军火后，却遭到不明匪徒袭击。为防止灾难发生，阿文决定与他的特工搭档阿琼合力夺回军火。

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: 求爱敢死队
programme.desc: 失恋的王晶认识了电台节目主持曾志伟。志伟自诩情场杀手向王晶提供追求秘诀，但当其本身周旋于妻子与情人的关系当中，却不知如何是好...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: 柠檬可乐
programme.desc: 就读女校高中的婷婷，因排演《罗密欧与茱丽叶》而与邻校男生Jackson戏假情真，爱情就在排练时萌芽。这是婷婷的初恋，但Jaskson却是一个变幻莫测的爱情玩家…

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: Ex-special forces operative Lung infiltrates a lawless cross-border crime compound after his reporter daughter, On Sum, goes missing while investigating it. When he discovers she is caught in a larger conspiracy, an enraged Lung fights his way through the criminal forces, determined to expose the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: 怒袭
programme.desc: 前特种兵阿龙为调查记者女儿安心在跨境犯罪园区失踪一事，孤身深入这座由金钱与血腥统治的人间炼狱，揭开电信诈骗、地下血库等黑暗内幕。当发现女儿已卷入更大阴谋，暴怒的阿龙化身冷酷杀神，以铁血手段血战罪恶势力，誓要揪出幕后黑手。

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: 回魂夜
programme.desc: 老妇神秘堕楼死亡，鬼魂于回魂夜当晚出现作祟。弄得一众大厦保安员不得安宁，并邀请了捉鬼大师Leo与女助手相助。Leo从老妇鬼魂得知，她是被儿子及媳妇所杀害，为了让老妇安息，Leo答应将夫妇二人绳之以法...

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: 济公
programme.desc: 周星驰饰演天庭中犯下天条的狂妄之神，被派往凡间化身为济公，并立志要感化三个注定沦为「九世乞丐」、「九世妓女」及「九世恶人」之凡人。如济公能于三天内顺利完成此事，他便可重返天庭。

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: 逆战
programme.desc: 国际安全局探员Jon在一次行动中遭上司Sean背叛，导致几乎全军覆没，自己亦身负重伤，脑中残留的弹头如定时炸弹般随时可能夺命。为圆母亲心愿，他远赴马来西亚寻找失散多年的兄长，却意外卷入一宗绑架案。追查之下，发现绑匪竟是兄长万阳，而幕后黑手正是Sean！

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: 凌晨两点半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂灵山探险，传说山中埋着千年女尸，千年不灭之阴火，进去的人都逃不出来。凌晨两点半，依成的朋友先后突然消失。在森林搜索期间，依成进入无限轮回的灵异空间，更恐怖的事情却接踵而来…

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: 魔警
programme.desc: 孤僻尽责的警员王伟业在值班时误救重伤垂死的悍匪韩江，却不知对方正是血腥残暴的「鬼王党」首领。韩江伤愈后率部再掀连环血案，让极度自责的王伟业瞬间陷入疯狂心魔，在扭曲的正义与精神崩溃的边缘痛苦徘徊。为了弥补致命过错，他决定彻底释放心中的恶魔，以魔制魔。

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: 我爱神仙遮
programme.desc: 推土车司机阿成，在工作时忽遇地陷而堕入一地下古庙，无意中成为油纸伞妖的主人。她更将自己现身的秘密及超凡的法力告知阿成。地盘工目凡叔嗜赌，欠下恶少高利贷，恶少垂涎凡叔之女美色，要凡叔以女还债；阿成得悉后请伞妖戏弄恶少，并暗助凡叔在赌场获胜，清还债项。惟此神伞之秘密却被恶少发现…

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: 煞面迷影
programme.desc: 当年轻母亲为女儿莫名失踪而苦恼时，一连串怪异的事件接踵而至。这都可能与二十年前的意外亡魂为复仇归来有关…

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: 叶问
programme.desc: 咏春大师叶问的功夫在中国各地备受推崇。正值日本侵华，叶问被迫离开家园并要找工作养家糊口。他唯有无奈地以咏春拳教导学生自卫训练，以赚取生活费用。

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: 三十处男
programme.desc: 设计师赵宇庭被批算三十岁前结婚，会被妻子克死，赵父遂严禁赵宇庭结交异性。但限期将届，他急不及待觅对象。荔玲与母亲同为死人化妆师，为了交男友改为新娘化妆，此时她认识了赵宇庭...

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: 窥情
programme.desc: 波子一夜用望远镜窥看家邻近四周时，揭发了一宗命案。但经警方调查村内居民，包括富商情妇Rita、邮差、纸店主老王及其妻子等人，揭开彼此间错综复杂的情欲关系之同时，还是不知谁是受害人，谁是凶手… 于是，波子决定用自己的方法继续调查…

programme.title: 窥情
programme.desc: 波子一夜用望远镜窥看家邻近四周时，揭发了一宗命案。但经警方调查村内居民，包括富商情妇Rita、邮差、纸店主老王及其妻子等人，揭开彼此间错综复杂的情欲关系之同时，还是不知谁是受害人，谁是凶手… 于是，波子决定用自己的方法继续调查…

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: 龙门飞甲
programme.desc: 本片重拍自1966年经典武侠片《龙门客栈》，当时东厂与西厂宦官掌控朝政，腐败横行。侠客赵怀安与一群刺客联手，秘密铲除宦官势力，维护忠良与国家安定。

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: 千王斗千霸
programme.desc: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动。两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决。

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: 除暴安良
programme.desc: 三名持枪劫匪抢劫了一批正在运送的新发行货币，刑警常勇奉命展开调查。随着线索逐渐浮现，常勇成功击毙一名劫匪。然而，其他两名劫匪不甘就此罢手，乘乱密谋抢劫金厂的黄金。常勇凭藉精密的部署，成功粉碎了他们的计划，将不法分子绳之以法。

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: 龙的传人
programme.desc: 青年周小龙离开纯朴的离岛到香港发展。他的师叔欺骗小龙参加桌球比赛，并以他父亲的地皮作为赌注。小龙最后输掉了比赛，幸得他青梅竹马的朋友毛毛鼓励，把自家的田地也作为赌注。小龙最后能否把自己的土地赢回来？

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: 宝贝计划
programme.desc: 城中著名的「盗贼三人组」受聘以3000万元绑架一名婴孩。当他们发现黑帮不仅企图吞掉赎金，更要置婴孩于死地后，决定担起保护婴孩的责任，并护送他平安回家。一方面要躲避警方追捕，另一方面又遭黑帮穷追不舍，三人即使危机四伏，仍誓死守护婴孩。

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道长与徒弟隐居于偏远村庄。某日，玛利亚修女计画重建一座荒废已久的教堂，却意外唤醒沉睡多年的僵尸黑袍传教士。全镇顿时陷入恐慌，面对传统茅山术失效的绝境，一眉道长唯有与西方驱魔神父联手，融合中西驱魔之法，展开一场惊心动魄的驱魔大战。

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: 南北妈打
programme.desc: 关德兴年青时与李消云相恋，遭母亲反对，只好和周申玉结婚。关的儿子关仁坚工作上认识了文文。申玉发现儿子追求的女友文文，竟是消云的女儿。两个妈打情敌又一次碰头，再斗个你死我活。

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: 铁线功夫拳
programme.desc: 武术宗师梁坤为保护心爱的女人毅然退隐江湖，不料他的隐忍却换来了爱人的惨死。意识到宿命避无可避，他重返武林，在丐帮帮主苏灿的鼎力相助下，梁坤杀出一条血路，誓要向那些冷血仇敌讨回血债。

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: 逃学威龙三之龙过鸡年
programme.desc: 富商王百万被发现离奇死于酒店房间，由于周星星与他极为相似，星星再次接受任务，作卧底调查这宗谋杀案。王百万生前与妻子感情早已破裂，妻子因此成为头号嫌疑人。然而，在调查过程中，星星发现王百万的友人林大岳同样形迹可疑……

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: 风流冤鬼
programme.desc: 红歌女阿花遭大户陶老爷奸杀，陶宅即常闹鬼，后陶老爷亦神秘死亡。陶之后人陶明嗜赌如命，更因鬼魂作怪而欠下钜款。明妻暗中将陶宅售予杨教授夫妇，即遇上怪事连篇...

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: 少年陈真之乱世英雄
programme.desc: 电影讲述清末上海的小人物陈真，在经历苦难及面对无数挑战后，蜕变成长为民族英雄的故事。

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: 画皮
programme.desc: 书生王怀卿卖画，为要筹药费救患重病的妻子，途中意外遇上雀妖的追击，幸得狐妖小容相救。为躲避雀妖，王怀卿将小容带回家中，三人随即陷入一场情感困局，而一段凄美的人妖虐恋亦随即展开。

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: 关云长
programme.desc: 这是一场发生在三国动荡时期的史诗式之旅。曹操试图招揽关羽加入他的阵营，但关羽忠于他的结拜兄弟刘备，也是曹操的敌人。当关羽试图从曹操手上救出刘备的小妾时，迫于无奈要大开杀戒。最后他能否杀出重围？

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: 少年叶问之危机时刻
programme.desc: 1917年，少年叶问初到香港求学。英文演讲比赛当天，学校发生一宗惊天绑架案，全校同学都被挟持。面对眼前的危机，叶问挺身而出，发现绑匪竟然是自己的师父和好兄弟。少年叶问在危机时刻可否打败绑匪，从而伸张正义？

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: 新宿事件
programme.desc: 偷渡到东京的铁头与一帮华人在当地艰难求生，并逐渐建立起一股黑帮新势力。当铁头取得居留权，决心退出江湖、展开新生活时，势力的急速扩张却引来各方势力围剿。面对警方大举扫黑，加上兄弟无情出卖，他最终被迫重返江湖。

programme.title: 新宿事件
programme.desc: 偷渡到东京的铁头与一帮华人在当地艰难求生，并逐渐建立起一股黑帮新势力。当铁头取得居留权，决心退出江湖、展开新生活时，势力的急速扩张却引来各方势力围剿。面对警方大举扫黑，加上兄弟无情出卖，他最终被迫重返江湖。

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: 打雀英雄传
programme.desc: 足智多谋的麻雀英雄，为避免年轻电脑专家的麻雀馆落入麻雀千王手上，不惜重新出山与千王鏖战。

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: 六耳猕猴
programme.desc: 生命之树被烧毁后，世间陷入一片混沌。为拯救苍生，孙悟空决定回到过去，帮助生命之树复活。因为失去了金箍棒，孙悟空力量时有时无，只得找回儿时的自己，一同前往寻找时间之力。不料，六耳猕猴却想据为己有，两人就此爆发激战。

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: 追女三十六房
programme.desc: 故事描述一间「猛男训练中心」专门教授男人在情场上的杀着。可惜校长与其女友缠绵时不幸暴毙，学校三位教授想出招数争夺学校拥有权，闹出连场笑话...

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: 龙虎武师
programme.desc: 香港动作电影向来以龙虎武师的真功夫蜚声国际。这部纪录片向过去所有的龙虎武师致敬，并用上超过两年时间梳理了海量的影像资料，更采访了无数动作特技演员分享拍摄时的辛酸事迹，当中包括著名武打巨星成龙、甄子丹及洪金宝。

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: 天官赐福
programme.desc: 康熙少年嗣位，太后急欲替他完婚，遂选纳大臣之女纳兰琼瑶为妃，但琼瑶为争取婚姻自由离家出走，康熙亦乐得不用成婚。后来康熙微服下江南，却偶遇女扮男装的琼瑶…

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Undercover police officer Shan is sent to prison to befriend crime boss Tin and gather evidence. After Tin’s release, Shan helps him rise through the ranks by eliminating rivals. But when his contact with police arouses suspicion, Shan’s cover is exposed, leaving him in a deadly predicament as a secret that could change everything emerges.

programme.title: 黑白潜行
programme.desc: 警校生阿山奉命卧底监狱，接近犯罪集团二把手阿天，暗中搜集其犯罪证据。阿天出狱后，阿山协助他以铁血手段一路厮杀，最终登上社团话事人之位。然而，阿山频繁与警方接触的行迹逐渐败露，卧底身份被社团识破，瞬间陷入生死危局，而一个足以颠覆一切的秘密也即将浮出水面。

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: 爱的世界
programme.desc: 李子良丧妻后，与两个儿子相依为命。妻子的巨额医药费令子良经济十分拮据，受同事教唆往马场孤注一掷，迫得向高利贷借款，从此子良债台高筑，疲于奔命，没有时间与儿子沟通，父子疏离。与此同时高利贷不断登门恐吓，骚扰儿子，最终弄至悲剧发生…

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: 错爱迷踪
programme.desc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小说家，两人一见钟情感情迅速升温。原来女孩已悄然落入惊天迷局，全因小说家的前女友是个毁容的女鬼，她借用人面还魂复仇，与前男友联手开启夺命惊吓。

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a “Phantom Bullet” that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: 消失的子弹
programme.desc: 民国初年，一家兵工厂发生离奇连环命案。死者皆死于枪击，现场却遍寻不到弹头，引发幽灵子弹索命恐慌。警政官松东路与热血神枪手郭追受命联手侦破此案。随着调查深入，两人发现阿森纳内黑幕重重，而真相竟隐藏在一个关于正义与人性堕落的惊人诡计之中。

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: 神勇双妹唛
programme.desc: 故事描述一对表姐妹梁山伯与祝英台乃斗气冤家，两女为争夺神秘俊男阿山欢心，却惹来大圈杀手威吓逼害，更陷入一场宝物争夺战。两女身陷险境，惟有摒弃前嫌，联手反抗……

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: 白发鬼
programme.desc: 年轻俊秀，生于名门望族的日籍华人林保，自幼失去父母，与大学好友川村感情深厚。二人都对美少女琉璃子心存爱慕，但川村自怜身世，不敢与林保争夺，林保顺利娶得琉璃子为妻。林保出国公干期间，川村和琉璃子耐不住寂寞，有了奸情。不久之后，林保竟在一次滑雪中意外身亡...

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: 飞龙再生
programme.desc: 香港特警阿狄在跨国追捕人蛇集团时，为救圣童不幸溺毙，却意外在「再生龙章」圣光中重获新生，并获得惊人的自愈能力。岂料宿敌同样夺取神力，设局步步追杀。退无可退的阿狄孤身深入虎穴，在幽暗古堡展开一场拳拳到肉、生死一线的终极激战。

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: 让子弹飞
programme.desc: 悍匪张牧之劫持火车，冒充新任县长强横进驻鹅城。本想靠升官发财大捞一笔，却撞上了只手遮天的当地地头蛇恶霸黄四郎。在满嘴谎言的骗子师爷马邦德的利益周旋下，黑白两道展开一场智力与火力的巅峰对决。在这场荒诞的杀戮游戏中，且看子弹如何飞往最终的真相。

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: 我的野蛮同学
programme.desc: 在一间Band5学校有个打擂台的传统，学生会在课室将很多张书桌拼成一个擂台，在擂台上进行决胜去解决一切争执。四个性格各异的少年石头、Edward、亚凤、Seven意外地成为朋友，共同经历了难忘的成长体验...

Featuring some of the Premier League's greatest number ones, the show examines how one of football's most specialised positions has been transformed.

programme.title: Night Drama Serial "The Blue Flowers and the Ceramic Forest" Ep. 15 (R)
programme.desc: In Hasami, Nagasaki Prefecture, ceramics are made through a division of labor among local craftspeople. Aoko (Matsui Rena), who grew up there and works as a porcelain painter, enjoys a quiet life until Tatsuki (Ichinose Hayate), a solitary potter, arrives from Finland. When he declares that his pottery needs no painted decoration, Aoko feels he is rejecting not only her work but her entire community. Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.

programme.sub-title: Mission: a bread oven for our grandmothers
programme.desc: A gathering in Dordogne to celebrate grandmothers: this is the new challenge for Nans and Mouts. Setting off from Limoux, in the Aude region, where the temperature is hardly inviting, the two companions embark on a journey of about one hundred kilometers and set out to build a bread oven.

programme.title: Nus & Culottes
programme.sub-title: Mission: a tribute to our grandmothers
programme.desc: How can you build an oven, like in the good old days, without money or equipment? Nans and Mouts have twelve days to build it, make it mobile, learn how to bake bread and reach Sarlat, 200 kilometers away. That is where they want to organize a memorable celebration to honor grandmothers.

programme.title: Escapades En Suisse Italienne
programme.desc: Accompanied by freestyle champion Deborah Scanzio, we set off by bike from Pescium following the Strada degli Alpi, a fabulous route along which we discover a fascinating crystal cave.

programme.title: Un Barrage Contre Le Pacifique
programme.desc: Indochina, 1931. Cheated by the corrupt colonial administration and the mother of two grown-up children, Mrs Dufresne is doing everything in her power to save her flooded, uncultivable rice fields. A stifling family drama set behind closed doors and an uncompromising portrayal of the colonial system, based on the famous novel by Marguerite Duras.

programme.title: France-Cambodge, Si Loin, Si Proche
programme.desc: How did Cambodia, devastated by one of the deadliest genocides of the 20th century, become the host of the 20th Francophonie Summit? What remains, 163 years after the protectorate chosen by Norodom I, of the bond linking Phnom Penh and Paris? A look back at a turbulent yet uninterrupted relationship.

programme.title: Cambodge, Les Traces Cachees De La Langue Francaise
programme.desc: Passionate about the French language, content creator Athena Sol wonders why the 20th Francophonie Summit is being held in a country where French is far from being widely spoken. Through archive footage and with the help of Linda Nguon, creator of the Banh Mi podcast, she sets out to investigate.

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth stet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The stet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their sarate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains.

programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert.
